boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named, map-listed destinations on Sewanee’s University Avenue corridor, connecting the Domain with the Sewanee Village.

cards.title: Taylor's Mercantile: gifts and flowers
cards.subtitle: University Avenue corridor — 10 University Ave
cards.notes: Walk the University Avenue corridor to browse the shop’s listed gifts, home décor, floral arrangements, and event-design offerings.
cards.short_summary: A shop stop for gifts, décor, and floral work.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor's Mercantile is listed at 10 University Avenue and offers unique gifts, home décor, flower arrangement, and event design.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current shop hours before visiting.

cards.title: LUNCH: a food stop on the avenue
cards.subtitle: University Avenue corridor — 24 University Ave
cards.notes: Use the village stretch of University Avenue for a meal stop at LUNCH; check the restaurant directly for its current menu and service.
cards.short_summary: A named restaurant destination in the village corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: LUNCH is listed at 24 University Avenue in Sewanee.
cards.access_notes: Check the restaurant’s current service details before going.

cards.title: Blue Chair Cafe: breakfast and dinner
cards.subtitle: University Avenue corridor — 35 University Ave
cards.notes: Plan a café meal along University Avenue: the local business listing identifies Blue Chair as serving breakfast and dinner.
cards.short_summary: A café and dinner destination on the village side of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Blue Chair Cafe & Tavern is listed at 35 University Avenue as a breakfast cafe and dinner restaurant.
cards.access_notes: Visit for the café or restaurant service; verify current hours directly.

cards.title: The Lemon Fair: Sewanee keepsakes
cards.subtitle: University Avenue corridor — 60 University Ave
cards.notes: Browse the University Avenue shop for clothing, jewelry, accessories, home goods, and Sewanee items, including Sewanee Angel merchandise.
cards.short_summary: A long-running village shop with Sewanee-related goods.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lemon Fair is listed at 60 University Avenue with clothing, jewelry, accessories, home goods, and Sewanee items.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current retail hours before visiting.

cards.title: Sewanee Auto Repair: vehicle service
cards.subtitle: University Avenue corridor — 76 University Ave
cards.notes: Keep this University Avenue destination in mind when arranging vehicle maintenance or repair while living or traveling on the Mountain.
cards.evidence_claim: Sewanee Auto Repair is listed at 76 University Avenue in Sewanee.
cards.access_notes: Call ahead to discuss service availability and scheduling.

cards.title: Sewanee Post Office: mailing services
cards.subtitle: University Avenue corridor — 94 University Ave
cards.notes: Use the University Avenue post office for listed carrier services, general delivery, retail-label support, and international Priority Mail options.
cards.short_summary: A federal postal-service stop in the Sewanee Village.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sewanee Post Office is at 94 University Avenue and lists carrier, general-delivery, Retail Label Broker, and Priority Mail International services.
cards.access_notes: USPS lists retail hours Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–4 p.m., and Saturday, 9 a.m.–noon; verify before travel.

cards.title: University Bookstore: campus gear
cards.subtitle: University Avenue corridor — 120 University Ave
cards.notes: Stop along University Avenue when you need Sewanee gear; the village directory places the University Bookstore at this corridor address.
cards.short_summary: The village address for the University Bookstore.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sewanee Business Directory lists the University Bookstore at 120 University Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Confirm retail hours and available merchandise before visiting.

cards.title: Folks at Home: community support
cards.subtitle: University Avenue corridor — 141 University Ave
cards.notes: Use this University Avenue address as a contact point for assistance with transportation, daily tasks, activities, and health-and-wellness programs.
cards.short_summary: A local service organization with activity and wellness support.
cards.evidence_claim: Folks at Home is listed at 141 University Avenue and provides transportation, daily-task assistance, activities, and health-and-wellness program access.
cards.access_notes: Contact the organization directly to ask about eligibility and current programming.

cards.title: Hospitality Shop: secondhand goods
cards.subtitle: University Avenue corridor — 1096 University Ave
cards.notes: Browse this University Avenue thrift shop for used housewares and clothing; inspect items in person and ask staff about current stock.
cards.short_summary: A thrift stop for used clothing and housewares.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hospitality Shop is listed at 1096 University Avenue as a thrift housewares and clothing store with used merchandise.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current opening times before making the trip.

cards.title: Sewanee Inn: campus-side lodging
cards.subtitle: University Avenue corridor — 1235 University Ave
cards.notes: Use the inn as a named University Avenue lodging landmark when coordinating visiting family, guests, or an on-the-Mountain overnight stay.
cards.short_summary: A lodging destination on the University Avenue approach.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sewanee Business Directory lists the Sewanee Inn at 1235 University Avenue, Sewanee, Tennessee.
cards.access_notes: Check availability, rates, and guest policies directly with the inn.
